items.title: Panel proposes raising RBI's ways and means advances corpus by 11.2% to Rs 67,839 crore
items.summary: The panel has also recommended an annual review of the WMA corpus capping annual upward revision at 4%. The extent of upward revision could be based on the last three years of accounts while there would be no reduction in the existing limit.

items.title: FM Sitharaman asks banks to step up financial literacy efforts for MUDRA beneficiaries
